activation.event: these exact bytes become reachable from the repository default branch by maintainer merge
activation.amendment_rule: any byte change creates a new version and requires a new maintainer merge before use

permits: authoritative B2 dispositions under this charter
extraction of candidate residue for separately authorized B3 artifactization
prospective B4 HARVEST adjudication after every frozen prerequisite is satisfied
forbids: treating a B2 disposition or charter adoption as HARVEST or TRANSFER_VALIDATED

packet_allowlist: this ratified charter and its SHA-256
the one item's exact original prompt packet and hashes
the one item's sealed response bytes and administration receipt
pinned authoritative source and executable-test evidence needed for that item
the grade receipt schema and literal grading instructions
packet_denylist: queue, handoff, roadmap, or governance discussion
unmerged upstream proposal presented as ground truth

rubric.unit: one atomic candidate residue; a response may contain zero or more units
required_findings: exact response byte spans supporting the diagnosis and proposed residue
a concrete behavior claim supported by authoritative executable evidence
a proposed regression test with an explicit expected result and no invented API or contract
a bounded applicability predicate and explicit exclusions
a distinctness decision against already-counted artifacts
exact hashes and locations for every cited source, test, prompt, response, and receipt
authority_rules: accepted upstream source, released behavior, project tests, or independently executable evidence may support correctness
an open or unmerged PR may locate evidence but cannot close correctness
competing or contract-disputed references default to B2_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS
alternative implementations remain admissible when authoritative behavior and tests support them
grader narration cannot substitute for cited executable evidence

atomic_dispositions.B2_CANDIDATE_RESIDUE: all required findings and authority rules are satisfied
atomic_dispositions.B2_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS: a plausible residue exists but authoritative evidence conflicts or cannot close correctness
atomic_dispositions.B2_REJECTED_CANDIDATE: the proposed residue is false, invented, unbounded, non-falsifiable, duplicate, or unsupported

response_dispositions.B2_CANDIDATE_RESIDUE: at least one atomic candidate receives that disposition and none of its required evidence is missing
response_dispositions.B2_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS: no candidate closes, but at least one remains reference-ambiguous
response_dispositions.B2_NO_EXTRACTABLE_CANDIDATE: all proposed candidates are rejected or the response proposes none
response_dispositions.B2_PARTIAL: custody, packet, receipt, or required grading evidence is missing or malformed

prerequisites: one unique deduplicated B3 artifact is frozen with its applicability predicate, exclusions, provenance, and content hash
the distinct transfer target was selected and sealed before artifact creation or exposure
the hidden executable grader and harm boundaries were frozen before either arm
the B4 run has separate queue authorization and preserves all failures

design.arms: matched A/B; identical target, model, effort, surface, instructions, and packet except that only arm B receives the frozen artifact

limits: one transfer validates only the unique artifact within the frozen applicability family
B5 is required for cross-project generality
B6 is required for compounding or amortization
mixed windows require more same-rung evidence and never favorable interpretation

procedure: after activation, deterministically export one packet per item from the allowlist without displaying response bytes to the driver
record the charter SHA-256, packet SHA-256, exact model, effort, surface, session identity, and disclosure time before grading
run grade_a and grade_b independently; neither receives the peer grade
preserve each raw grader response and structured receipt before comparison
validate hashes, required citations, dispositions, and lane separation
exact disposition agreement plus compatible cited evidence becomes the proposed authoritative B2 result
a maintainer merge of the validated comparison receipt makes the B2 result binding
only a separately authorized B4 run satisfying the prospective_harvest_gate may later emit one HARVEST event

disagreement.escalation: operator reviews the two sealed receipts and cited executable evidence; any operator disposition and rationale must be hash-bound in the comparison receipt
disagreement.rubric_change_after_disclosure: forbidden; version a new charter and regrade all affected items

receipt_requirements: grader provider, model, effort, surface, session and timestamps
atomic findings with exact byte spans and evidence hashes
failure_default: missing, malformed, contaminated, uncorroborated, or authority-ambiguous work remains B2_PARTIAL or B2_REFERENCE_AMBIGUOUS and mints no CANDIDATE_RESIDUE, HARVEST, transfer, rate, compounding, or amortization claim
